page.notes: The first word is a fragment: "fet" is "set" (end of "set" from the previous line), continuing the sentence from the previous page. "sarua" (line 'Canonibus sarua') is doubtful; probably "larua", marked [?]. The Greek "ὑπεροχὴ" is copied from a small, blurred print; accents and final letter are doubtful, marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s in the text, per the rules, but the letters "s" in the source are kept unchanged in the transcription.
